say:2:1630503001:0.text: Professor Hepler is finally teaching us transfiguration!
say:2:1630503001:0.source_cn: 赫普老师终于要教我们变形术了！

say:3:1630503002:0.text: I was so excited I couldn't sleep last night! I kept imagining myself turning into some random critter.
say:3:1630503002:0.source_cn: 是啊，一想到自己可以变成别的小动物，我就激动得一宿睡不着觉！

say:4:1630503003:0.text: Just imagine—me, soaring through the sky as a majestic bird!
say:4:1630503003:0.source_cn: 想想看，我的身子可以变成鸟飞到空中！

say:5:1630503004:0.text: Turning into a bird? That's advanced-level stuff! We're nowhere near that yet...
say:5:1630503004:0.source_cn: 变鸟可是高级课程，我们应该学不到那里吧……

say:6:1630503005:0.text: Fine, then I'll be a squirrel and climb the tallest tree in school!
say:6:1630503005:0.source_cn: 那，能变个松鼠也是极好的啊！我要爬上这里最高的那棵树！
